Built a clean, modern ecommerce home page for "Maren & Co." retail brand.

**Files created:**
- `index.html` — minimal shell, loads React 18 + Babel standalone, includes skip-link
- `styles.css` — modern design system (warm earth palette, Fraunces serif + Inter sans, rounded cards, soft shadows)
- `app.js` — React-style component tree

**Components:** `Announcement`, `Header`, `Hero`, `Marquee`, `FeaturedProducts` (with filter chips), `ProductCard`, `Deals` (with live `Countdown`), `Categories`, `Editorial`, `Testimonials`, `Newsletter` (with validation), `Footer`, `Toast`, `Artwork` (procedural SVG so no external images).

**Sections:** featured products with category filters & wishlist/add-to-bag, weekly deals grid with countdown timer, shop-by-category, editorial/journal stories, customer reviews, newsletter signup.

**Accessibility:**
- Skip-link, semantic landmarks (`header`/`main`/`footer`/`section` with `aria-labelledby`)
- All icon buttons have `aria-label`s; wishlist uses `aria-pressed`; cart/wishlist counts announced
- Filter chips as `role="tablist"`; star ratings have `sr-only` text equivalent
- Newsletter form has labeled input, `aria-invalid`, `role="status"` for feedback
- Decorative SVGs marked `aria-hidden`, meaningful ones get descriptive labels
- Visible `:focus-visible` outlines, `prefers-reduced-motion` disables marquee
- Toast uses `role="status" aria-live="polite"`
